analysis.title: Howmet Aerospace Inc. (HWM) - Strength in operating performance and the end markets, Buy
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on HWM after 3Q26 results and raises its 12-month price target to $303 from $298. The price is $199.22, which implies 52.1% upside.
3Q26 revenue, EBITDA and adjusted EPS all beat FactSet consensus. Adjusted EPS was $1.46 vs consensus $1.37, revenue was $2.7bn vs $2.59bn, and adjusted EBITDA was $879mn vs $837mn on a 32.5% margin.
Revenue growth by end market in 3Q26: commercial aerospace +32% yoy, defense +10% yoy, commercial transportation +28% and gas turbines +45%.

HWM raised full-year 2026 guidance on every key metric. Revenue is now $10.29-$10.31bn (prior $10.00-$10.10bn, consensus $10.12bn), and adjusted EPS is $5.49-$5.51 (prior $5.23-$5.31, consensus $5.34).
HWM gave initial 2027 revenue guidance of about $11.5bn, up about 12% yoy, vs consensus of $11.58bn. This is slightly below the Street.

Management expects the industrial gas turbine business to double from its 2025 base in about 3 years. Other cited growth drivers are higher US defense spending, including US missile production ramps, and commercial aerospace, where an aircraft supply-demand mismatch supports the aftermarket and OE demand.
Engine Products was the standout segment. Revenue was $1,451mn (+31% yoy, 4% above GS), and margin was 36.3% (210bps above GS, +640bps yoy). The segment absorbed 520 net headcount in the quarter.
Fastening Systems missed GS on margin. Revenue was $630mn (+41% yoy, 3% below GS), and margin was 24.8% (220bps below GS, down 330bps yoy), diluted by the CAM acquisition.

Forged Wheels revenue was $327mn (+32% yoy, 16% above GS), but margin was 22.9% (250bps below GS, down 220bps yoy) on higher aluminum cost pass-through. Engineered Structures revenue was $295mn (down 2% yoy, up 8% excluding the Savannah divestiture) with margin up 330bps yoy to 20.3% after exiting lower-margin business.
Cash generation was strong. Adjusted free cash flow was $562mn vs $423mn a year ago and vs consensus of $465mn. HWM repurchased $500mn of stock in the quarter, and net debt/EBITDA was 1.3X.

GS raised its 2026-2030E EPS to $5.51/6.50/7.58/8.78/10.16 from $5.35/6.47/7.52/8.57/9.66, reflecting revisions to segment revenue and margin assumptions. The price target still rests on 32.5X CY27E EV/EBITDA, unchanged.

HWM has raised its 2026 guidance at each quarterly update. Revenue guidance went from $9.00-$9.20bn in February to $10.29-$10.31bn in October, and adjusted EPS guidance went from $4.35-$4.55 to $5.49-$5.51.

market_movers.rationale: Buy reiterated after a 3Q26 beat and a 2026 guidance raise, with the target lifted to $303 from $298 on higher segment revenue and margin assumptions. The target uses 32.5X CY27E EV/EBITDA.

earnings_insights: HWM 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported at $1.46 vs FactSet consensus $1.37 and vs GS estimate $1.37 (+53.6% yoy from $0.95).
HWM 3Q26 revenue reported at $2.70bn (+29% yoy), 5% above GS estimate of $2.584bn and above FactSet consensus of $2.59bn.
HWM 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported at $879mn on a 32.5% margin, 5% above FactSet consensus of $837mn.
HWM 3Q26 adjusted free cash flow reported at $562mn vs $423mn a year ago and vs consensus of $465mn.

Company 2026 guidance (updated October): revenue $10.29-$10.31bn vs consensus $10.12bn, adjusted EBITDA $3.325-$3.335bn vs consensus $3.26bn, adjusted EPS $5.49-$5.51 vs consensus $5.34, FCF $1.95-$2.05bn vs consensus $1.93bn.
Company 2027 revenue guidance of about $11.5bn (+12% yoy) vs consensus of $11.58bn.

GS estimates adjusted EPS of $5.51 for 2026E, $6.50 for 2027E and $7.58 for 2028E (prior $5.35/$6.47/$7.52). GS 2026E revenue is $10,309.6mn (prior $10,118.1mn), and 2027E revenue is $11,609.2mn (prior $11,502.5mn).
Segment operating margin was 30.2% (up 310bps yoy, 30bps above GS). Total operating margin was 29.1%, 40bps below GS. The effective tax rate was 20.0% vs 22.0% GS estimate.
charts_described: Exhibit 2 tabulates HWM 2026 guidance by update. Revenue went from $9.00-$9.20bn (February) to $9.575-$9.725bn (May), $10.00-$10.10bn (August) and $10.29-$10.31bn (October). Adjusted EPS went from $4.35-$4.55 to $4.88-$5.00, $5.23-$5.31 and $5.49-$5.51.
Exhibit 1 tabulates the HWM adjusted 3Q26 variance vs GS. Total sales were $2,703mn vs GS $2,584mn, segment operating profit $817mn vs $774mn, and diluted EPS $1.46 vs GS $1.37.
